'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Battle of Lake Chad]]
***Around 200 fighters are killed in clashes between [[Boko Haram]] and [[Islamic State – West Africa Province|ISWAP]] near [[Lake Chad]] in [[Nigeria]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/2/10/556573/World/Africa/Jihadist-turf-war-kills-around--in-Nigeria-sources.aspx (AFP via ''Al-Ahram'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Twenty [[Pakistani Taliban]] insurgents are killed in raids on hideouts in [[North Waziristan District]] and [[Darra Adam Khel]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/pakistan-says-troops-killed-20-militants-in-a-region-bordering-afghanistan/ar-AA1Q9YKc (MSN)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[China–United States relations]]
**[[China–United States trade war]]
***[[China]]'s [[Ministry of Commerce (China)|commerce ministry]] suspends a ban on the export of [[gallium]], [[germanium]], [[antimony]], and other materials used in the [[Semiconductor industry in China|semiconductor industry]], to the [[United States]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/11/09/china-suspends-ban-on-exports-of-gallium-germanium-antimony-to-us.html (CNBC)]
*[[2025 BBC editorial bias allegations]]
**[[Tim Davie]], [[Director-General of the BBC|Director-General]] of the [[BBC]], and [[Deborah Turness]], CEO of [[BBC News]], resign over the controversy. [https://www.theguardian.com/media/2025/nov/09/tim-davie-expected-to-resign-bbc-director-general (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**At least two people are killed as [[Typhoon Fung-wong (2025)|Typhoon Fung-wong]] makes landfall over [[Luzon]], [[Philippines]]. Over 900,000 people are evacuated and rescue operations for victims of the previous [[Typhoon Kalmaegi]] are suspended. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cq509yj82y8o (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/philippines-evacuates-100000-people-fung-wong-intensifies-into-super-typhoon-2025-11-09/ (Reuters)]
*At least seven people are killed, thirteen are rescued, and 280 others are reported missing when a boat carrying hundreds of [[Rohingya]] refugees sinks near [[Langkawi]], [[Malaysia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/migrant-vessel-sinks-off-malaysia-thailand-border-hundreds-missing-2025-11-09/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belgium–United Kingdom relations]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] announces it is deploying its [[British Armed Forces|military]] to [[Belgium]] to help protect its airports amid a series of drone incursions over the country's [[airspace]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3dn2ep584ko (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
**Four inmates are killed and 30 others are injured during a [[prison riot]] in [[Machala]], [[El Oro Province|El Oro]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-prison-riot-violence-machala-drug-trafficking-e5eba46aabaad6bd49ad8f6d189c9fce (AP)]
**Following the riot, 27 inmates at the Machala prison are found dead by [[asphyxiation]], with investigations ongoing to determine the circumstances of the deaths. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/11/10/authorities-say-31-died-in-ecuador-prison-many-asphyxiated (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Maldives–Sri Lanka relations]]
**[[Sri Lanka]]n [[Ministry of Public Security (Sri Lanka)|public security minister]] [[Ananda Wijepala]] says that [[Law enforcement in Sri Lanka|police]] and [[Sri Lanka Navy|navy officers]] have been sent to the [[Maldives]] to cooperate with local authorities after the [[Maldives National Defence Force|Maldivian military]] seized a Sri Lankan ship with over 300 kilograms of [[heroin]] on Friday. [https://english.news.cn/20251109/f8f4c3e4e4964a4d87187fef6e84ed86/c.html (Xinhua News)] [https://hirunews.lk/goldfmnews/429738/sri-lanka-to-bring-back-suspected-drug-traffickers-and-vessel-from-maldives (Hiru News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Israel]] confirms that it received the remains of [[Israel Defense Forces|soldier]] [[Hadar Goldin]], who was killed in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] two hours after the ceasefire that ended the [[2014 Gaza War]] between [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] militants and Israel. [https://apnews.com/article/mideast-wars-israel-hamas-gaza-news-11-09-2025-54a4f07644bb15621950a23187a8c758 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 League of Legends World Championship|2025 ''League of Legends'' World Championship]]
**In ''[[League of Legends]]'' [[League of Legends in esports|esports]], [[T1 (esports)|T1]] of the [[League of Legends Champions Korea|''League of Legends'' Champions Korea]] become the first team to win three consecutive [[League of Legends World Championship|world titles]] after defeating fellow [[Korea e-Sports Association|South Korea]]n representatives [[KT Rolster]], 3–2, in [[2025 League of Legends World Championship final|the final]] in [[Chengdu]], China. T1's [[Gumayusi]] is named the [[most valuable player]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20251109-faker-s-t1-win-third-back-to-back-league-of-legends-world-crown (AFP via France 24)]
